content:
We have now made our way to the Black Friday main event, with Amazon’s biggest sale of the year delivering an incredible $100 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, but the MacBook deals are going crazy here today too, folks.

We have M5 MacBook Air at a wild $400 off the list and MacBook Neo at $100 off with deals starting from $599, but Amazon has also dropped the price even lower on both the brand new M6 MacBook Pro at $250 off and the PROLED model at $300+ off. Check it all out below.

M5 MacBook Air Black Friday deals

A clear headliner of this year’s deals is M5 MacBook Air. We are talking about an absolutely wild $400 discount here on the mid-range and 24GB machines to rival the best deals we have tracked on anything all year. And while the most affordable model is not down quite that low, it is still at a seriously notable $300 off right now at $999 in all four colorways:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $999 (Reg. $1,299) – $300 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,199 (Reg. $1,599) – $400 off!
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,399 (Reg. $1,799) – $400 off!
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,199 (Reg. $1,499) – $300 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,399 (Reg. $1,799) – $400 off!
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,599 (Reg. $1,999) – $400 off!

MacBook Neo Black Friday deals

You better get on these deals quick folks. While the upgraded 512GB model Black Friday price seems to be stable still, prices are starting to jump around on the base variant at $599 – get in there as soon as possible if you want to land the color you’re after at $100 off:

  • MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (Reg. $699) – Now even lower
  • MacBook Neo 512GB $699 (Reg. $799) – Now even lower

M6 MacBook Pro Black Friday deals

As we detailed on 9to5Toys today, perhaps the most surprising Mac price drop of the year is landing on the brand new M6 MacBook Pro. This thing literally just released a few weeks ago and you can already score one at $250 off – these are the lowest prices ever, right from the entry 16GB/1TB up through to the 32GB/1TB config:

  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,749 (Reg. $1,999) – $250 off all-time low
